extensions:

Nushell uses `$env.PROMPT_COMMAND` for prompt configuration. Pass a minimal env config file via `--env-config`:

```yaml
extensions:
  term:
    shell: nu
    shell-args: ["--no-config-file", "--env-config", "shells/nu-env.nu"]
    prompt: ">"
```

The env config file (`shells/nu-env.nu`):

```nu
$env.PROMPT_COMMAND = {|| "> " }
$env.PROMPT_INDICATOR = ""
$env.PROMPT_COMMAND_RIGHT = {|| "" }
```

## Basic Usage

```{term}
echo "Hello from Nushell"
```

## Structured Data

```{term}
[[name, age]; [Alice, 30], [Bob, 25], [Carol, 35]] | where age > 26
```

## Pipelines

```{term}
[1 2 3 4 5] | each { |x| $x * $x }
```

## Math

```{term}
[10 20 30 40 50] | math avg
```
